import json, math
reg_tx=[12.7,15.7,19.5,21.0,24.2,28.7,31.7,32.1,29.1,23.0,17.1,13.5]
reg_tn=[4.5,5.1,7.4,9.4,12.1,15.4,17.3,17.2,15.1,11.7,8.1,5.6]
reg_tt=[8.6,10.4,13.5,15.2,18.1,22.1,24.5,24.6,22.1,17.4,12.6,9.6]
reg_pr=[104.9,81.7,57.1,79.7,51.5,28.4,11.9,17.1,40.9,101.1,108.2,136.9]
por_pr=[151.0,97.8,101.1,95.5,85.6,33.7,16.6,29.3,68.2,148.9,165.9,153.3]
por_tx=[14.0,15.0,17.0,18.1,20.3,22.7,24.3,24.8,23.5,20.7,16.8,14.7]
def hav(a,b):
    R=6371.0; la1,lo1=map(math.radians,a); la2,lo2=map(math.radians,b)
    d=math.sin((la2-la1)/2)**2+math.cos(la1)*math.cos(la2)*math.sin((lo2-lo1)/2)**2
    return 2*R*math.asin(math.sqrt(d))
d=dict(
 reg_precip_sum=round(sum(reg_pr),1), por_precip_sum=round(sum(por_pr),1),
 reg_jja_precip=round(sum(reg_pr[5:8]),1),
 reg_jja_share_pct=round(100*sum(reg_pr[5:8])/sum(reg_pr),1),
 reg_apr_oct_tmean=round(sum(reg_tt[3:10])/7,2),
 reg_apr_oct_precip=round(sum(reg_pr[3:10]),1),
 reg_minus_por_aug_tmax=round(reg_tx[7]-por_tx[7],1),
 por_over_reg_precip_ratio=round(sum(por_pr)/sum(reg_pr),2),
 km_regua_to_porto=round(hav((41.1629,-7.8003),(41.2322,-8.6791)),1),
 outline_km2=round(269166/100,0),
)
print(json.dumps(d,indent=1))
json.dump(d,open('derived.json','w'),indent=1)
